integrity: The all-parameter mathematical claim is supported by an explicit proof; finite checks only corroborate that proof. Neither absolute priority nor external expert certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Counts only initially fixed and primitive period-two states for synchronous strict-minority open-neighborhood updates on labelled friendship graphs. Does not count basins or transients. The fixed-state cardinality is shared by a separately published stochastic dynamics model with a different update rule; the primitive period-two classification remains qualified by literature-priority risk.
title: Exact recurrent-state census for anti-coordination on friendship graphs
